captive_summary: Small-scale LNG export proposal (Watson Island LNG Corp / "WILNG") on the former Skeena Cellulose pulp-mill site, Prince Rupert BC. Never advanced past a July 2014 city exclusivity agreement; local coverage explicitly notes no development timeline, financing, gas supply, or ship-access details were ever published, and by early 2015 the project had gone silent ("all quiet on the WILNG front"). No BC EAO environmental-assessment filing, no engineering/FEED study, and no power-supply design of any kind (grid vs on-site gas) was ever published before the project was abandoned.
confirmed_how: Local Prince Rupert civic-affairs blog (northcoastreview.blogspot.com) contemporaneous coverage: 2014-07 post reports the City-WILNG exclusivity agreement and states the proponent's plans "seem fairly limited" with no timeline/financing/gas-supply/ship-access details disclosed; 2015-02 post confirms the project had stalled with no further public activity since July 2014. No BC EAO project registry entry or engineering filing found (BC EAO project search and Wayback CDX queries for the project turned up nothing).
